title: The Surrender of Santiago An Account of the Historic Surrender of Santiago to General Shafter, July 17, 1898

As the American forces move into Santiago, the triumph is palpable, with accounts of the soldiers' emotions and the reactions of Spanish troops as they relinquish power.
